g.text: Scenario: Capture and correlate a bounded event
g.title: Trigger: An agent, Git, Entire, CI, or GitHub source emits a relevant event. Preconditions: Source identity is known.; Event contains a run or source id. Controls: event_id; run_id; payload_digest; repository_id; commit_sha Outputs: Evidence event, artifact references, and rebuildable lineage projection. Failures: Duplicate is safely ignored.; Redaction failure rejects event.; Queue or database outage delays projection.; Unknown identity is quarantined. Signals: Ingest latency.; Duplicate counter.; Dead-letter count.; Projection lag.; Payload digest.

ID: agent_runtime Responsibility: Produce model decisions, tool calls, edits, and bounded outputs. Owner: Agent runtime operator Runtime: Codex or compatible agent State variables: run_id; trace_id; tool_call_id Invariants: Runtime events carry source identity and run identity. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents/integrations-observability @ current-2026-08-30

ID: source_adapters Responsibility: Translate provider records into bounded canonical events. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: source_event_id; adapter_version; idempotency_key Invariants: Provider-specific differences do not change canonical identity fields. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: event_bus Responsibility: Buffer canonical events and provide retry/backpressure behavior. Owner: Platform operator Runtime: Managed queue or durable local queue State variables: event_id; delivery_count; dead_letter_state Invariants: Delivery is at-least-once and consumers are idempotent. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: ingest_worker Responsibility: Accept events, enforce idempotency, and coordinate canonical persistence. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: event_id; ingest_status; payload_digest Invariants: A retry does not create duplicate evidence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: canonicalizer Responsibility: Redact secrets, classify sensitivity, canonicalize payloads, and compute digests. Owner: Security and Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: redaction_status; sensitivity; payload_sha256 Invariants: Secrets are blocked before durable persistence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: provenance_ledger Responsibility: Store typed facts, JSONB payloads, stable identities, and critical relationships. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL State variables: run_id; event_id; repository_id; commit_sha; checkpoint_id Invariants: Critical references satisfy relational constraints.; Facts are append-only or dispositioned. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-constraints.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: artifact_store Responsibility: Store large logs, diffs, traces, and transcripts behind access control. Owner: Platform operator Runtime: Content-addressed object storage State variables: artifact_sha256; uri; sensitivity; retention_class Invariants: Digest and access policy remain attached to every artifact. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: projection_worker Responsibility: Build lineage, stack, review, freshness, and query projections from immutable facts. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: projection_revision; source_event_id; lag Invariants: Projections can be rebuilt from the ledger. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: read_model Responsibility: Serve current lineage, stack, review, and exact-head freshness queries. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL read projection State variables: head_sha; review_status; projection_revision Invariants: A projection never authorizes a head different from its assessed head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

text.tspan: 1. Agent trace event / trace export or bounded event API
4. Normalize incoming event / internal JSON API
5. Persist fact and relationships / PostgreSQL transaction
6. Store large content by digest / content-addressed object API
